exposure to DCS/PLC systems preferred. || Engineer (Civil): Full time B.E/B.Tech in Civil Engineering with minimum 3 years post qualification experience in RCC/steel structures, building/road maintenance, civil projects, sanitary & fire water lines, tendering in PSU/large private sector; fertilizer/chemical/refinery experience preferred. || Dy Manager (HR): Full time MBA / 2-year PG Degree or Diploma in Personnel Management & Industrial Relations / Labour & Social Welfare with minimum 8 years post qualification executive experience in HR in PSU/large private sector; Law degree desirable. || Officer (HR): Full time MBA / 2-year PG Degree or Diploma in Personnel Management & Industrial Relations / Labour & Social Welfare with minimum 3 years post qualification executive experience in HR in PSU/large private sector; Law degree desirable.
